name: Rock Imperium Festival
description: Four-day rock/metal festival in a harbour park in Cartagena
note: MARILYN MANSON (Thu 1 Jul, welcome day); Evanescence, Children of Bodom
details: Rock Imperium is a rock and metal festival in Parque El Batel on the Cartagena waterfront; the 2026 edition drew more than 50,000 visitors. The 2027 edition runs 1-4 July: Marilyn Manson headlines the welcome day on Thursday 1 July (listed on marilynmanson.com), Evanescence headline 2-4 July. Also announced: Helloween (40th anniversary), Bruce Dickinson, Children of Bodom, Mayhem, Motionless in White, Paradise Lost, Fear Factory, GWAR. Passes from 215 EUR + fees via promoter Madness Live (sale since 6 July 2026). Hotels in Cartagena or Murcia; nearest airports Murcia and Alicante.
